facts.text: Il San Pietro di Positano is set into the cliffside on the Amalfi Coast.
facts.excerpt: Nestled into the cliffside, this exclusive sanctuary embodies the essence of timeless Italian hospitality.

facts.text: The rooms are carved into the cliff overlooking the Mediterranean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Carved into the cliff overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, our rooms are a combination of understated luxury, intricate detail, and unique design.

facts.text: Rooms feature hand-painted ceramic tiles, custom-made furniture and fine Italian textiles.
facts.excerpt: hand-painted ceramic tiles, custom-made furniture, and fine Italian textiles evoke the region’s rich heritage

facts.text: Classic rooms have a private terrace overlooking the sea.
facts.excerpt: Uniquely designed and furnished rooms providing all the modern comforts and amenities, with a private terrace overlooking the sea.

facts.text: The Prestige rooms with a Positano view have large furnished terraces overlooking the town of Positano and the islands of Li Galli and Capri.
facts.excerpt: Large furnished terraces overlook the town of Positano and the islands of Li galli and Capri.

facts.text: The Virginia suite occupies an entire floor, with a privileged entrance to the swimming pool and direct lift access.
facts.excerpt: Suite 59 occupies an entire floor, with a privileged entrance to the swimming pool and direct lift access.

facts.text: The Signature rooms were designed by Fausta Gaetani.
facts.excerpt: The Signature rooms, designed by Fausta Gaetani, offer spacious bathrooms, unique features and stunning Mediterranean views.

facts.text: The beach club is a private beach in a natural cove with clear Mediterranean waters.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to the only private beach in Positano, an exclusive natural cove with crystal-clear Mediterranean waters.

facts.text: An elevator cut into the cliff runs from the lobby straight to the beach club.
facts.excerpt: Take an elevator cut into the cliff straight from the lobby to this hidden gem

facts.text: The swimming pool is set on a terrace overlooking the sea and the coastal village of Praiano.
facts.excerpt: Dive into the vibrant atmosphere at our swimming pool, set on a terrace overlooking the sea and the charming coastal village of Praiano.

facts.text: The regulation-size tennis court sits between the rock face and a pebble beach by the sea.
facts.excerpt: nestled between the rugged rock face and pristine pebble beach, our regulation-size court, with its dramatic backdrop is the perfect setting for a friendly match by the sea

facts.text: Guests can charter the hotel's private yachts, The Dreamer and The Joey II, to explore the Amalfi Coast, Capri, Ischia and the Gulf of Naples.
facts.excerpt: Explore the captivating beauty of the Amalfi Coast, Capri, Ischia and the Gulf of Naples aboard Il San Pietro’s private yachts.

facts.text: The hotel's organic gardens span ten cascading terraces and supply vegetables, herbs and citrus.
facts.excerpt: Spanning ten cascading terraces, our organic gardens supply the hotel with fresh vegetables, herbs, and citrus, ensuring a true farm-to-table experience.

facts.text: Zass restaurant has panoramic sea views.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an elevated culinary experience at Zass, our Michelin-starred restaurant with panoramic sea views

facts.text: Carlino offers relaxed beachside dining with local cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Carlino offers a relaxed beachside dining experience, serving authentic local cuisine crafted from the freshest organic produce.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports that founder Carlino Cinque opened the hotel in 1970 and it has never left the family since.
facts.excerpt: Founder Carlino Cinque opened the hotel in 1970 with just 33 rooms, and it has never left the family since.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler mentions La Prairie treatments at the spa.
facts.excerpt: The La Prairie treatments at the spa gave me a reason to retreat out of the sun

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler places the hotel about a mile down the coast from the center of Positano.
facts.excerpt: About a mile down the coast from the center of Positano

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports the hotel has an age limit for children, with ages 10 and up allowed.
facts.excerpt: this hotel has an age limit for children (ages 10 and up are allowed)

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists a small gym with sea views and yoga and Pilates classes.
facts.excerpt: Spa, a small gym with sea views, yoga and Pilates classes, and a tennis court

facts.text: Il San Pietro di Positano is a three-Michelin-keys hotel.
facts.excerpt: this three-Michelin keys hotel is more than a destination
